nodes.label: Graphify Honesty Rules
nodes.rationale: Never invent an edge; always show token cost; never hide cohesion scores; never run HTML viz on a graph with more than 5000 nodes without warning. Design intent: build trust through transparency and audit trails.

nodes.label: Node ID Format Convention
nodes.rationale: IDs must be deterministic from label alone (no chunk number suffix) and use full repo-relative path with every directory level to avoid orphan ghost-duplicate nodes between AST and semantic extractors.

nodes.label: Confidence Score Rubric
nodes.rationale: Discrete set of values (0.95, 0.85, 0.75, 0.65, 0.55) chosen because models follow discrete rubrics better than continuous ranges; bimodal distribution (>50% at 0.5, >40% at 0.85+) was observed in production when using range guidance.
